dedupe_keys.name: simetra ritm3 transport modelling integration platform

description: RITM³ is SIMETRA's integration platform for transport modelling and planning in Russia. It provides a common environment in which transport models, traffic data and planning tools are combined, and it runs on the Russian operating systems Astra Linux and RED, so it can be deployed on customer servers or in the cloud. SIMETRA also resells and supports PTV Visum and Vissim, LISA and INES signal control software and TomTom traffic data, and uses them in its planning projects. On 4 December 2025 SIMETRA announced that it will build a digital twin of the transport system of the Leningrad region for the ANO Directorate for development of the transport system of St Petersburg and the Leningrad region, based on RITM³. Coverage is Russian cities and regions where SIMETRA works. Access: a commercial product delivered through projects and licences; no public download or price list was found on the pages read. Caveats: no technical documentation was found on the public pages read. It supports regional transport digital twins, network flow and capacity planning, and is comparable to the PTV and Aimsun platforms catalogued here.
